Maria (AE): Quick heads-up — ACME Health wants to expand the POC. They want a private deployment with BYO-KMS + HSM, plus the ability to swap in a quantized 70B model during peak. Can we confirm feasibility, rough timeline, and pricing impact?
Ravi (SE): Got it. Which model variant exactly and what's their target latency / throughput for the POC?
Maria (AE): They said '70B or equivalent, quantized ok for peak', target is conversational UX: 95th pct <200ms for short prompts (<128 tokens), sustained 3000 tokens/sec for batch rerank jobs, and end-to-end entity-extraction F1 >0.78 on their eval set.
Casey (Solutions Eng): Important to separate two flows: interactive generation (low latency) vs batch rerank (high throughput). We can hit low-latency with smaller context / optimized kernels. 3000 tps for rerank likely needs dedicated pool config or task parallelism.
Sasha (Infra Eng): Network/security blockers: ACME's infra forbids outbound to S3 and requires models to be staged on an internal artefacts store. They also want KMS in their VPC and SIEM via syslog. That affects deployment time.
Maria (AE): They attached a security questionnaire earlier. Vault/KMS requirement is non-negotiable for their legal team. Any quick callouts on one-time setup effort?
Ravi (SE): BYO-KMS/HSM: we support customer KMS via customer-managed keys in our private deployment flow, but hsm integration + attestation needs our infra team. Estimate 1–2 weeks of engineering effort for the POC to wire KMS and validate key rotation/audit logs. If they insist on air-gapped on-prem, add 2–3 weeks for packaging and on-site validation.
Casey (Solutions Eng): For the evaluation harness: ask them for a 500-prompt golden set + failure cases (edge prompts). We'll run both the baseline and candidate models and produce a metric pack (F1, BLEU-ish for structured outputs, MAP for rerank). Please have them upload to our S3 test bucket or an internal artefact location we can access.
Casey (Solutions Eng): Example curl for our eval runner (they can run locally and share results):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/eval/run \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <POC_TOKEN>" \
 -d '{"model":"open-70b-quant","prompts":"s3://acme-poc/prompts.json", "metrics":["f1","map"], "max_tokens":128 }'
```
Ravi (SE): For latency: to meet p95 <200ms we should recommend a smaller low-latency model variant for interactive, and reserve the quantized 70B for rerank batch jobs. That avoids impossible tradeoffs.
Sasha (Infra Eng): Deployment-wise: since they block S3 egress, options: 1) we stage weights on their internal store (they provide path + creds), 2) use an appliance image we ship (air-gap). Option 1 is faster but requires IAM work from their infra. Option 2 needs an on-prem package and courier; longer timeline.
Maria (AE): Pricing — they asked whether POC usage is billed. What are options?
Casey (Solutions Eng): Typical: Hosted POC — we provide $X credits (cover first ~200k tokens for free). Private/Dedicated trial — we bill a reduced setup fee + prorated reserved capacity. BYO-KMS/HSM adds a one-time integration setup fee (we can discount for enterprise deals). I'll let Sales finalize exact numbers, but we should set expectation: private = higher one-time but predictable monthly.
Ravi (SE): Also note cost tradeoff: running quantized 70B in dedicated pool vs smaller non-quantized model — quantized reduces memory but may increase CPU decode overhead. For their throughput target, 2x A100-class GPUs (or equivalent) may be required for sustained rerank; otherwise shard across multiple smaller machines.
Sasha (Infra Eng): Blocker checklist we need from ACME: VPC peering details or internal artefact store access, desired retention for audit logs (they asked for 12 months), SIEM syslog endpoint, and KMS admin contacts. Without those we can't start private deployment.
Maria (AE): Okay — I'll push for those items. Can we propose a conservative timeline in the meantime?
Casey (Solutions Eng): Tentative: 1) Hosted eval of prompts on our infra — 3 business days once prompts are in. 2) Private deployment with BYO-KMS (network ready + artefact staged) — 10–14 business days. 3) Air-gap/on-prem appliance — 3–5 weeks including validation.
Ravi (SE): I'll draft a minimal test plan for the team: 500 prompts, 3 stress rerank jobs (10k queries), and a latency sweep. I'll post the test plan doc link here when ready.
Maria (AE): Perfect. Also ACME asked about rollback and canary routing if model swap causes regressions — we should confirm we can do canary at the route level and auto-fallback to hosted small model.
Casey (Solutions Eng): Yes — canary + automatic fallback supported. We'll map the rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with metrics gating on the eval suite.
Sasha (Infra Eng): FYI: vault-bot just posted that KMS onboarding template is updated — vault-bot: please link the template.
vault-bot: KMS onboarding template: https://internal.redwood/templates/kms-onboarding (read-only).
Maria (AE): Great. Next steps I will: 1) ask ACME for artefact access, SIEM/KMS contacts, and their 500-prompt set; 2) schedule a 30m tech sync with Ravi/Casey/Sasha for tomorrow; 3) confirm pricing expectations with finance and reply. Anyone object?
Ravi (SE): No objections. I'll review the minimal test plan tonight.
Casey (Solutions Eng): No objections. I'll prepare the canary rollout checklist and a short doc on cost/throughput tradeoffs.
Sasha (Infra Eng): I'll draft the infra pre-checklist (network + storage + KMS) and include the exact steps for staging model weights.
Maria (AE): Awesome — thanks team. I'll update ACME after the tech sync and attach the checklist.
